name: Avatares AI - Admin - Set Active Ingest Profile

parameters.query:
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS tmp_set_active_profile;

CREATE TEMP TABLE tmp_set_active_profile AS
SELECT
  NULLIF('{{ $json.body.profileId || $json.body.profile_id || "" }}', '')::uuid AS profile_id;

UPDATE ingest_profiles
SET
  is_active = false,
  updated_at = now()
WHERE is_active = true
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM ingest_profiles p
    JOIN tmp_set_active_profile t ON t.profile_id = p.profile_id
    WHERE p.is_enabled = true
  );

UPDATE ingest_profiles p
SET
  is_active = true,
  updated_at = now()
FROM tmp_set_active_profile t
WHERE p.profile_id = t.profile_id
  AND p.is_enabled = true;

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM ingest_profiles p
      JOIN tmp_set_active_profile t ON t.profile_id = p.profile_id
      WHERE p.is_enabled = true
        AND p.is_active = true
    )
    THEN true
    ELSE false
  END AS ok,

  CASE
    WHEN NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM tmp_set_active_profile
      WHERE profile_id IS NOT NULL
    )
    THEN 'Missing profileId'
    WHEN NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM ingest_profiles p
      JOIN tmp_set_active_profile t ON t.profile_id = p.profile_id
      WHERE p.is_enabled = true
    )
    THEN 'Profile not found or disabled'
    WHEN NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM ingest_profiles p
      JOIN tmp_set_active_profile t ON t.profile_id = p.profile_id
      WHERE p.is_enabled = true
        AND p.is_active = true
    )
    THEN 'Profile could not be activated'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS error,

  (
    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
      'profileId', p.profile_id,
      'profileName', p.profile_name,
      'avatar', p.avatar,
      'avatarShort', p.avatar_short,
      'scene', p.scene,
      'assetType', p.asset_type,
      'workflow', p.workflow,
      'model', p.model,
      'seed', p.seed,
      'version', p.version,
      'autoPromoteLatest', p.auto_promote_latest,
      'isActive', p.is_active,
      'isEnabled', p.is_enabled,
      'createdAt', p.created_at,
      'updatedAt', p.updated_at
    )
    FROM ingest_profiles p
    JOIN tmp_set_active_profile t ON t.profile_id = p.profile_id
    WHERE p.is_enabled = true
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS profile;
